name: qoder-status-typebar
description: Live usage readout for the Qoder desktop composer: generation speed, cache hit rate, time-to-first-token and context usage, injected into the chat input bar next to the built-in context widget.
descriptionZh: Qoder 桌面端输入框底栏的实时用量读数：生成速度、缓存命中率、首字延迟与上下文占用，注入在内置上下文控件左侧。
